title: Crosbie and Alleyne’s
html_source: C. W. Alleyne, a solicitor, had offices at 24 Dame Street (on the corner of Eustace Street) in central Dublin just south of the Liffey. The same Mr. Alleyne appears in “Counterparts,” ‘Dubliners,’ and repeatedly mentions his absent partner Mr. Crosbie.
